controls.name: C1_probe_finds_the_known_instance
controls.must_fire_because: a negative result is only evidence if the search could have found something; G30's F2 is the one instance known to be real
controls.can_fail_because: a wrong paragraph matcher, or reading the wrong provenance key, would return a clean tree for every spike including the one already proven defective
controls.null_must_contain: G30's F2 explanation matching its own observations

controls.name: C2_probe_B_reaches_real_falsifiers
controls.must_fire_because: check B reporting zero must mean 'no contradictions', not 'nothing was examined'
controls.can_fail_because: if no RESULT.md paragraph named a falsifier, B would print 0 contradictions while having checked nothing

falsifiers.name: F1_check_A_is_too_noisy_to_ship
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the share of cited numbers absent from their falsifier's observations is >= 25% across the tree, i.e. the ordinary case looks like the defect
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a low absent-rate with the known instance still flagged
falsifiers.refutes: REFUSE check A if it cannot separate the known defect from ordinary derived numbers
falsifiers.fires_when: the share of cited numbers absent from their falsifier's observations is >= 25% across the tree, i.e. the ordinary case looks like the defect

no_deps_reason: reads every spike's committed provenance.json and RESULT.md; it has no single upstream spike
falsifier: Check A separates the known instance from derived numbers at a usable rate, or check B finds a contradiction somewhere in the tree
